name: Liquid d1-3B

based_on.note: Not Qwen: built on Liquid's LFM2.5-VL-3B.

summary: Liquid AI's 3B decision model with vision; 8 ms per decision on an RTX 4090, 30 ms on an M5 Pro (card). Liquid reports it as the best decision model under 10B on Decision Index 0.2.1 (48.57). Decision model: it answers typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) with probabilities through a Jev-compatible /v1/systemone endpoint. It does not chat or write text.

practical_baseline.reason: Decision models are not ranked by the chat-model baseline policy; pick by hardware and API.
